known_secrets.text: I have followed a herd deviation that led to a partially collapsed terrace path.
That path is not recorded in any village route maps.
It appears to connect grazing zones to the upper palace-monument levels.
I have not shared this discovery.
Animals refuse to cross certain stone thresholds without obvious cause.
These thresholds are not consistent across seasons.
I suspect the mountain itself influences movement patterns.
Revati once told me an animal recovered faster after being taken near the river below the monument.
